name: admin-profile-rate-limit-and-lazy-avatar-fix
changes: Fixed administrator Full profile requests being blocked by the global 180 requests/minute safety limiter after avatar loading consumed the allowance.
Valid signed administrator sessions now use a separate 900 requests/minute operational safety allowance; invalid or missing admin tokens remain behind the stricter public limiter.
Admin customer profile photos now lazy-load only near the viewport instead of all at once, preventing large request bursts on accounts with many users.
Duplicate administrator profile-photo fetches are deduplicated in memory and photo responses allow short private browser caching.
All portal/service-worker cache versions were bumped so the admin fix replaces stale cached files.
notes: Normal customer realtime presence remains connected even when no listener is currently online.
Run the normal database initialization during deployment.
Public/customer abuse protection remains at 180 API requests per minute; the larger admin allowance applies only when a signed administrator token is valid.
Administrator profile avatars are loaded on demand to keep Render/Supabase request usage low even with large customer lists.
